invariants.rationale: The method receives dedupedRecords as a parameter and is likely to expect it not to be null for normal operation.
The context parameter is used in subsequent method calls, so it should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The table parameter is used to access getIndex() and other methods, indicating that it should be non-null.
If dedupedRecords is not empty, its first element should not be null to avoid downstream errors in processing.
The tag method calls table.getIndex(), so getIndex() should not return null at this entry point.
